name: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among The Stars

reviews.review_description: ...it needs tweaking, so that those of us who don't live in mansions can play too. I'm told that's already being worked on. I won't get my hopes up, but it's considerate. I'll check for the update regularly, then try again.

developer_response.body: Hi AngelaKnight. Thanks for the feedback. Yes, the MR version needs around 2m x 2m due to the room scaling, as mentioned in the product description. We are working on the VR version which will be a free upgrade which will help with this. Sorry you could not experience the game :(

reviews.review_description:
I'd love to review this GAM, but, even though i bought and paid for it, I'm not allowed to play it because i play seated and don't have a dedicated VR room with a large space to move around in. I'm not looking for a workout, just abfun game.

I'm disgusted by this highhanded attitude. Who do the devs think they are?

Gross!

developer_response.body: Hi. Sorry you were not able to experience the game. Yes, the mixed reality room scaling needs 2m x 2m, however, the VR update should help resolve this and give a seated option.

reviews.review_description: The game is not playable on my quest 3 headset. I can't even click to agree to the terms. I hope it gets fixed soon. I was really looking forward to this game. Very disappointing!

developer_response.body: Hi. Thanks for leaving feedback. Are you trying to use your controllers? If so, please put them down and use your hands as PHM:JATS is a hands first game. If you still having problems then please contact us at support@maze-theory.com

reviews.review_description: I think the game has huge potential, but it needs a lot of tweaking on the hand tracking, half the time things don’t move right or just completely glitch out, might just be a cause of the vrs ability but it’s not very fun to play when you can barely grab stuff. Again though, I think it has great potential, it just needs work.

developer_response.body: Thanks for the feedback. Is it possible to contact us on support@maze-theory.com to understand a little more about your experiences with the hand tracking so we can look to see we can improve this?

reviews.review_description: It was telling me I needed a 6.5 x 6.5 foot space even when I did.  I had to get about a 9 x 9 foot space.  But, then it got stuck at the EULA screen, I couldn't click, there was no input enabled.  I really want to check it out so I hope this is fixed soon.

developer_response.body: Thanks for giving us feedback. Were you trying to use the controllers with the game and on the EULA screen? If so, please put the controllers down. PHM:JATS is a hands first game where you interact via your hands - even the EULA screen. Let us know if this helps.

reviews.review_description:
I tried to give this a chance, but didn't last long. This game can't be played seated. Im not sure it can be played standing,either, because parts of the ship I was meant to interact with were spawning through my walls and outside my playspace (roughly a 9×12 ft space). My boundary was set up correctly and other MR games worked properly. Also, pointer rays coming out of my wrist?!? 
This game would have benefitted from some thorough testing during development.

developer_response.body:
Hi Andy73, thanks for posting up your review and feedback.
We would love to understand a little more about what you found so that we can address these, is it possible to reach out to use via support@maze-theory.com ?

reviews.review_title: Good play of game, saving bad bad bad
reviews.review_description: The gameplay is great, though halfway through one of the early tasks, my headset died and I had to plug it in. When I got back, I was softlocked because none of the components were loaded in. I had to reset my progress, thankfully it was very early in the game. I think some sort of level select or manual save mechanism would improve this

developer_response.body: Thanks for the feedback, we will pass this back onto the team

reviews.review_description: first one here. It’s a great game, I wish rocky used the same voice actor as in the movie. But other than that, ITS A AMAZING GAME!!!!!!

developer_response.body: Thanks  for the review and feedback. Yes, a different voice actor for Grace. We would love to understand more about your hand interactions - would you mind reaching out to us at support@maze-theory.com  and tell us a little more so we can learn and improve where needed?

reviews.review_title: This is garbage, mixed reality nonsense.
reviews.review_description: Like the review above its ridiculous for people who don't have the room or are disabled, you won't be able to play,  due to the design of this game.  First , let's start with AUGMENTED REALITY SUCKS!!! Honestly,  who thought bringing virtual stuff into a crappy ,camera viewed reality ,was like this is awesome and we need to waste resources on implementing the whole game like this. While there are legitimate uses for AR , games are not one of them. I want to feel like I am in the story but visually impossible due to AR , it's like a Spotify episode with a few VR aspects. The controls are buggy and the glitches seem to be spilling over to my device,  making me restart my headset just to be able to access certain basic functions.  This game has amazing potential but ONLY IF THEY SCRAP THE AR . VR is designed to make you feel like you are there being part of the story , but the developers clearly didn't understand or care about the quality of this app.  I understand why Meta implemented AR on their headsets,  it is a gimmick for most users, but only practical for design jobs. I am very disappointed  because I love this story so much but the developers trashed it . Unless the entire game is redesigned,  don't waste your money because you will be seeking a refund. 😡

developer_response.body:
Hi Mylaryn6 - thanks for posting your thoughts and opinions.
Mixed Reality may not be for everyone, we understand that which is why we also have a free VR update coming to the game as well so that players can decide how they want to experience the game.

reviews.review_title: Super fun to play with Rocky
reviews.review_description:

- Hand tracking is fantastic for this game but sometimes not always accurate
